Álex — 30-Day Plan

30 days to a stronger Use of English

One short session a day (~15 minutes). Every day is built from your own mocks — Use of English first, but reading, spelling and your Spanish false-friends too. Type or tap, press Check, get the answer and the reason straight away. Your progress is saved on this device.

The weekly rhythm: Word Formation → Transformations → Open Cloze → Reading → Spelling & False Friends, then repeat. A 1-minute speaking task (from your Photo Bank) is added every other day — a different topic each time.
